A '''palace''' located on a [[Unidentified Outer Rim moon|moon]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] was built by the [[Kumauri Empire]], but was a crumbling ruin by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Archaeologists during the Cold War explored the palace and discovered a fresco depicting the Empire battling the Republic, including an image of [[Vall Kumauri's flagship]].<ref name="The Palace of the Kumauri" />
